name: Neural Network Multiple Scattering Representation
aliases: Neural Network Representation of Multiple Scattering
Neural network model for multiple scattering
Compact Representation for Multiple Scattering using Neural Networks
definition: Uses neural networks instead of tables to represent multiple scattering, reducing memory usage from hundreds of MB to kB without significant reduction in quality.
summary: Neural Network Multiple Scattering Representation encodes multiple scattering effects in participating media using a compact neural network, replacing large lookup tables while handling arbitrary geometry and phase functions.
